candidates.title: id와 class로 요소 가져오기
candidates.concept_granularity: single sentence shape every DOM edit follows - take the document, get the element by its id, say which part of it, and assign the new value - where fetching by class returns however many matched, so one has to be picked by index

candidates.title: script 태그를 아래에 두는 이유
candidates.concept_granularity: single consequence of the page being read top to bottom - a script placed above the elements it touches runs before they exist, so it goes below them instead

candidates.title: 자바스크립트 반복문
candidates.concept_granularity: single construct repeating a block a counted number of times, whose counter has to be declared with let rather than var when anything inside the loop runs later than the loop itself

locators.heading: ## for 반복문, 탭기능 만들기 > ### for 반복문

candidates.title: 자바스크립트 함수
candidates.concept_granularity: single way to give a stretch of code a name, worth doing when it is long or used more than once, named starting lowercase and in camel case rather than with underscores

candidates.title: Array 자료형
candidates.concept_granularity: single way of putting many values in one variable in a definite order, which is what makes them sortable, sliceable between two positions, searchable and appendable at either end

candidates.title: Object 자료형
candidates.concept_granularity: single way of storing values under names rather than in an order, where only the value is really the data and the key is the name it is reached by

candidates.title: Array와 Object 중 무엇을 쓸까
aliases: 순서로 꺼낼 것인가 이름으로 꺼낼 것인가
candidates.concept_granularity: single question that decides between them - whether the data will be reached by position or by name, so a product's price is better kept under the name price than at some remembered index

candidates.title: 서버 렌더링과 클라이언트 렌더링
candidates.concept_granularity: single choice in what the server actually sends - a finished html page with the values already filled in, or an empty page together with the data, leaving the browser's javascript to put the two together

candidates.title: 자바스크립트로 html 만들기
candidates.concept_granularity: single alternative to hardcoding markup that would otherwise have to be edited whenever the data changes - either build the element, fill it, name its class and append it, or write the markup as a string and insert it at a named position; both add to what is there, so replacing the contents outright is the other option

candidates.title: select 태그 다루기
candidates.concept_granularity: single element read the same way as a text input - its chosen option comes out of its value, and it fires the same input and change events

candidates.title: forEach
candidates.concept_granularity: single method on an array that runs a callback once per element, handing it the element itself and, if asked for, the index counting up from zero

locators.heading: ## 웹서비스 방식 > ### Select 03 : forEach, for in 반복문

candidates.title: for in
candidates.concept_granularity: single loop over an object's entries as many times as it has them, naming the key each round so both key and value can be reached - as against the of form, which walks an array's values but gives no index

candidates.title: 화살표 함수
candidates.concept_granularity: single shorter syntax for writing a function, identical to the ordinary form except in how it treats this, most often used where a callback is wanted, and shortened further to just the parameter and the arrow when there is only one parameter

candidates.title: 함수와 화살표 함수의 this
candidates.concept_granularity: single difference that decides which form to use - an ordinary function redefines this to whatever it was called on, so inside an event callback it is the element listened to, while an arrow function leaves this as it was outside, which in the browser ends up being the global object

candidates.title: 서버에 요청할 때 정해야 하는 두 가지
candidates.concept_granularity: single pair of decisions behind any request - which data, named by a url the server's api document defines, and how, reading with GET or sending with POST - where typing an address is already a GET and submitting a form is already a POST

candidates.title: Ajax
candidates.concept_granularity: single way of making a request without the page reloading, which a plain GET or POST would force - with a callback for what to do when the answer arrives and another for when it fails, a failure usually meaning the url is not there

candidates.title: fetch
candidates.concept_granularity: single built-in that makes the same request without any library at all

candidates.title: JSON
candidates.concept_granularity: single form structured data takes while it travels - a server and a client can only exchange text, so an object or array is quoted into a string to be sent and turned back into one on arrival before anything can be picked out of it

candidates.title: sort() 함수
candidates.concept_granularity: single method that orders an array in place, comparing as text unless told otherwise - which is why numbers come out in an order nobody wanted, and why sorting numbers or objects means supplying a comparison callback

candidates.title: 정렬 콜백이 반환하는 값의 의미
candidates.concept_granularity: single rule the sort follows - it hands the callback two elements at a time and reads the sign of what comes back, a positive number putting the first one after the second, a negative one putting the second after the first, and zero leaving their order alone

candidates.title: filter() 함수
candidates.concept_granularity: single method returning a new array of the elements that passed a test, leaving the original as it was, so the result has to be kept somewhere to be of any use

locators.heading: ## Array 자주 쓰는 함수 > ### filter() 함수

candidates.title: map() 함수
candidates.concept_granularity: single method returning a new array with every element put through the same transformation, again leaving the original untouched

locators.heading: ## Array 자주 쓰는 함수 > ### map() 함수

candidates.title: DOM
candidates.concept_granularity: single object the browser builds by parsing the html, since the markup arrives as plain text and text cannot be manipulated - it is what every selector actually reaches into

candidates.title: script를 언제 실행할 것인가
candidates.concept_granularity: single consequence of the document being parsed top to bottom and synchronously - a script above the elements it touches finds nothing there, and one in the middle stops the parsing while it loads, which is why an external file is marked to load alongside the parsing and run either as soon as it arrives or once parsing is done; the other way is to wait for the event that says the document is built, or the one that says the images and stylesheets are in too

candidates.title: 브라우저가 제공하는 저장소
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of places the browser will keep data - one surviving until the user clears it and one cleared on leaving the site, both key and value and both limited to a few megabytes of text or numbers; a structured store for larger data, cookies for who the user is, and a cache holding the site's own files so they need not be downloaded again

candidates.title: 저장소에 넣기 위한 변환
candidates.concept_granularity: single conversion needed before an array or object goes into browser storage - it holds text only, so the value is turned into JSON on the way in and parsed back on the way out

candidates.title: 저장소의 자료를 수정하는 법
candidates.concept_granularity: single three-step routine that stands in for the edit operation browser storage does not have - read the value out, change it, write the whole thing back

candidates.title: find()와 findIndex()
candidates.concept_granularity: single pair of array methods taking a test and returning the first element that passes it or the position of that element, the position form answering with minus one when nothing passed, which is how presence is checked

candidates.title: 스크롤 구간에 값 대응시키기
candidates.concept_granularity: single technique beyond a one-way animation - a range of scroll positions is mapped onto a range of values by a straight line, so a property such as opacity moves continuously with the scroll instead of switching once

candidates.title: 마우스와 터치 이벤트
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of events a drag is assembled from - the button going down, the pointer moving, the button coming up, each carrying the pointer's coordinates - with touch equivalents on mobile where the coordinates come from a list because more than one finger may be down, and where the end event has to read the list of those that changed instead

candidates.title: switch 문
candidates.concept_granularity: single branching form testing one value against several cases, where each case must end in a break or execution falls through into the next, and where a default catches everything unmatched - narrower than the condition form, which can test anything
